objectives.text: Recognize which Java release a feature needs, such as lambdas (8), var (10), switch expressions (14) and records (16)
Rewrite an older idiom, such as an anonymous class or a colon switch, in its modern form
Inspect a short Java 8, 11 or 17 example, predict whether it compiles on JDK 25, and name the feature or migration issue behind the prediction

minutes.basis: Measured on 2026-11-08 from the final artifact bytes. modeledP50: p50 of authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py on the current artifact.html. modeledWorstPath: modeledP50 plus 2.0 minutes for the worst required route (the wrong-twice route): reading the feedback on a wrong release prediction (0.5), two failing runs of the NamesTest editor with Problems and Output read each time (1.0), and the wrong-first compile prediction retried (0.5). aboutLabel and budget equal the page's own about label, which is at least ceil(max(modeledP50, modeledWorstPath)) and within the 15 minute ceiling.

unverifiedItems: Sources were fetched live by the implementation owner on 2026-11-08 (HTTP status, final URL and hash in sourcesRef); no independent SME critic re-verified the claims under the minimum acceptance profile.

The in-page practice runner is a bounded model of Java, JUnit Jupiter and Mockito; its behavior was checked by the implementation owner only, not by an independent SME critic or against javac and the JUnit Platform for every input.
Compatibility is not assumed: older source often, but not always, compiles on JDK 25; removed APIs, tools, options and dependencies can break it (intake reconciliation education-05, java-sme-002).
